**What changed in the refinement.** The roadmap gap now uses `roadmap init --config` only. Per the init source, that branch resolves the root through the canonical resolver, creates only the `roadmap/` parent, and writes only `roadmap/roadmap.config.json`. It runs no scaffold, so `package.json` stays a byte-identical present home and no `roadmap/lib`, `roadmap/phases`, `roadmap/arcs`, `reviews/releases` or copied roadmap scripts appear. The config check tolerates the missing consumer schema seam, so it still exits 0 with a config-only root. | present home guard | `package.json` | no longer touched; added to the sha256 preservation guard |

Gate rationale is unchanged: all seven are honest absences. Lint has an empty eslint config and no eslint dependency. Types has no tsconfig or TypeScript sources. Unit, integration, build and e2e have no runner, targets, runtime or runnable app. Emit has no phases, no emit runner and no tsx/zod dependency, and none will be added. No npm install, cache, lockfile or network use is proposed.
